purpose: Teach: 後遺症/火葬/引き起こさ/漏らし/退去/服従/脱退/揶揄

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦争被害者の後遺症を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote about the long-term effects of war on survivors, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, methodical. Opens with the student's name — not correcting, but genuinely revisiting her work together. Steady pace. The tone of a teacher who remembers what her students wrote.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、火葬文化の地域差を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on regional differences in funeral practices after conflict.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Not defensive. Sakura meets her teacher's gaze directly. Slight pause before answering, as if double-checking the accuracy of her memory.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 災害が引き起こさせた社会変動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined how disaster reshapes society — the structural shifts.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost turning it over in her mind. Not a question, but an opening for more. Asuka speaks with genuine curiosity, as though drawing out the thread Sakura started.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、軍事機密を漏らした事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right — specifically the case of classified military information being leaked during the chaos.
lines.style: Direct and clear. No hesitation. Sakura's voice carries the weight of having thought this through. She doesn't rush, doesn't minimize the subject matter.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 占領地からの住民退去を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also looked at forced displacement from occupied territories.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Not leading — confirming. Asuka's tone carries recognition of the serious subject matter. She speaks slowly, as if honoring the weight of what Sakura researched.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、絶対服従の組織を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed authoritarian organizations and their demand for absolute obedience.
lines.style: Even, composed. Sakura answers with the precision of someone who knows her material. No apology in her voice, no performance. Just facts, clearly stated.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国連脱退の事例史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And historical case studies on withdrawal from the United Nations.
lines.style: Reflective, almost nodding to herself. Asuka's pacing slows — she's mapping the scope of Sakura's work with genuine respect. Warm recognition underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、揶揄的な政治風刺画を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the role of political satire and mockery in social commentary.
lines.style: Final answer, slightly settling — grounded. Sakura's voice carries quiet confidence. A small closing quality, as if she's finished laying out her work and is waiting for what comes next.
